reviews.text: Rollin helped with training of my very energetic puppy Dolly. He was patient, kind, professional and very knowledgable but most of all fun! Highly recommend!

Daisy (dog) and I had an amazing experience with Rollins. He is very knowledgeable and articulate. Very easy to follow along with the lesson and he understands what your dog needs. Worked with him three times and always got the most out of the lesson and am still applying those lessons today. I highly recommend.

Rollin helped us out so much with our new puppy a few months ago! When Frankie first moved in, she was exhibiting behaviors that neither my partner or I had experienced with any of our previous dogs. Rollin came in and helped us come up games, schedules and gave us the tools to help Frankie transition nicely into our home. We even signed her up for puppy obedience classes with Rollin at Urban Pet on Beverly Blvd. Without Rollin's help, we would have been lost. I highly recommend getting in touch with Rollin for all your puppy training needs!

Hiring Rollin was the best decision my wife and I ever made! He was professional, timely, knowledgeable and explained things to us so we could understand them. He made it simple and easy and was so positive and encouraging. Of course our dog, Jimi, LOVED him and we had the skills we needed to handle all the different behaviors. He sent us handouts after each session to refer to and had a quick response time through email. We highly recommend Sit With Rollin.
So kind, my dogs all love him and he has great resources!
Our training sessions with Rollin were jam-packed with techniques and tips that got our Bernedoodle through puppyhood  and into a well-behaved teenager. Plus, we had a lot of fun learning together.

Rollin's expertise and patience made training with my new rescue dog so easy and enjoyable. And went above and beyond, providing "handouts" with useful material as well as a lesson plan with homework in between sessions.

Rollin is an amazing dog trainer. I was struggling with serious behavior issues from my rescue dog, especially biting due to anxiety and stress on walks. It became difficult to take her out and even harder to keep a dog walker, and she couldn’t go outside without a muzzle. After just two sessions with Rollin, it felt like I had a completely different dog. She is now so much better behaved — no biting or jumping on walks for me or for dog walkers — and she no longer needs a muzzle. I highly recommend Rollin to anyone needing support with their dog.

We started off with group classes at Urban Pet with Rollin shortly after we finished vaccinating our rescue puppy, and followed up with private lessons when we started having some behavioral challenges during adolescence. In both settings, Rollin's instructions were instrumental in helping improve our confidence as first-time dog owners, craft new exercises and games for helping our dog learn basic commands and work through 'big emotions', and learn more about common  dog behavior.

What really stood out about Rollin's training was how we always left sessions feeling more empowered and excited about our relationship with our dog. It was really reassuring how Rolling was able to come up with corrective activities that were still fun and engaging, as well as make minor shifts in our strategies that had massive impacts. For example, we were really struggling with our dog trying to tear up yards or eat everything in sight on walks. Commands that previously worked suddenly seemed to go out the window. Within two sessions with Rollin, we noticed a night and day difference by making small changes like using a longer leash, taking a fun toy on walks, and practicing settle at home.

Our dog loves Rollin, and we're so happy that our friends recommended his group classes. I'd highly recommend!

I tried at least 3 different trainers for my reactive dog and Rollin was the best by far. Super calm and kind to my anxious pup, offered genuine insight into his behavioral issues and had simple, clear training that I could see working within the first session. If you need a dog trainer - I highly recommend Rollin!

Rollin worked with our dog Enzo. He exceeded my expectations in every way. He was knowledgeable, patient, and truly understanding of how dogs learn and communicate. From the very first session, it was clear that he was focused on positive reinforcement and building trust, not just quick fixes.

Rollin took the time to understand my dog’s personality and tailored the training to fit both my dog’s needs and my own goals. The results were noticeable quickly—better focus, improved behavior, and a much stronger bond between me and my dog.

We just had our first training session with Rollin and had the most wonderful experience. Rollin is a true professional from communication, personality and punctuality. He is skilled in his craft as a dog trainer. We recently adopted two yorkiepoo pups, shared our concerns and he helped address all of them. A one hour session flies by filled with knowledge to help us condition our fur babies while we put rollins tips into action. Even my little canelita who is really nervous warmed up to rollin, which speaks volumes. We will be doing more sessions with rollin in the future! Highly recommend rollin to anyone considering his services.

We were very impressed with our experience and plan to continue sessions. Training was hands on and effective. We left our session with action items to help our dog. Rollin is incredibly personable and a delight to work with. Highly recommend!!

Rollin was great with my puppy! He is gentle, caring and knowledgeable with everything about dogs. As a new dog mom he helped me with small to big questions and most importantly with training techniques. Absolutely recommend Rollin!!!

We had an excellent experience with Rollin as our in-home dog trainer for our Westie, Tamsey. He was incredibly attentive and patient, and what really set him apart was how clearly he explained why he does certain things and how his methods directly impact behavior. We were blown away with his deep knowledge on the psychology of dogs. That understanding made a huge difference for us, as owners.

For every trick or behavior we were working on, Rollin gave us multiple alternative ways to train it, which helped us find what worked best for Tamsey. He also left behind detailed handouts so we could reinforce everything properly after the session—something we truly appreciated.

We’ve had trainers before, but Rollin was hands down better than all the others. His knowledge, communication, and thoughtful approach made the training far more effective and empowering. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for real, lasting results.

We got a 8 week old Rhodesian Ridgeback puppy and everyone told us they are hard to train, stubborn and difficult dogs. We called Rollin in asap. Our dog (now 6 months) is a dream and we owe it to  Rollin. He is such an intuitive trainer and really understands exactly what the puppies/dogs are saying with their behavior. He’s incredible. Call asap if you need help. We plan on calling Rollin again once our boy enters his “teen years”! We hear that’s an entirely different and knew set of behaviors.

Rollin has a command of dogs and their behavior from the minute he meets them (and they meet him).  He has trained my puppy and made some corrections with an older dog of mine.  Now they even play together.  He is always on time and does the job.  I do recommend him for all dog "issues."

Rollin is an incredible trainer! Our dog is a rescue and has a few anxiety/fear behaviors that we were unsure of how to navigate. Working with Rollin has been the greatest gift. We're learning how to meet our dog where he's at and have noticed a significant impact. Would recommend Rollin to everyone, especially those with anxious pups!

Rollin is a true pro! He is so fantastic with our dogs and made us feel like any training is possible for those of us who don't know where to start. He is super knowledgeable and flexible for your lifestyle and what's best for your pup. Would recommend him to anyone!

Great trainer! He is very helpful in helping me train my puppy. She is at a crazy wild age as she is developing and he has given me very helpful tips and games I can play with her to keep her calm and get her energy out.

If you’re looking for the most technically proficient yet kind and empathetic trainer, look no further! I’ve been experiencing some puppy blues and anxiety regarding raising a rambunctious sweet 6 month old puppy.

Rollin not only teaches you all the necessary skills to ensure that your pup is trained and manageable – he goes above and beyond in making you feel seen/heard.

Seriously the best of the best!
Rollin really understands how to work with dogs and he is a great teacher. Even though our dog was a little older (4 years) we made a ton of progress.

We can’t say enough great things about our experience with Rollin Perry! Our Yorkie terrier mix, Milo, was extremely reactive to other dogs and people, making walks stressful and frustrating. We were at a loss and really needed help. From the moment Rollin arrived at our home (right on time!), he immediately knew how to handle Milo. What impressed us most was how quickly Milo responded—he took a liking to Rollin right away, and we saw real progress even during the first session.

It only took a few one-hour sessions for us to feel fully trained and equipped to handle Milo’s behavior. Rollin not only worked directly with Milo but also taught us how to confidently manage his reactivity. He offered helpful suggestions and even let us record the sessions so we could review them later, which was incredibly useful.

Thanks to Rollin, Milo is now much calmer around people and other dogs. Walks have become something I actually look forward to again. Milo now understands basic commands like “sit,” “let’s go,” “quiet,” “down,” and “stay.” Rollin was also amazing with our kids, showing them how to safely and effectively handle Milo.

Having Rollin come to our home was a game-changer—the convenience, professionalism, and results made the entire experience well worth it. We highly recommend Rollin Perry to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, patient, and effective dog trainer. He truly made a difference for our family and for Milo.

We had a fantastic experience. Rollin was great with our dog and with us! He has a common sense approach to understanding the psychology of your animal. We found the training easy to incorporate into our daily routine. Highly recommend.

Rollin was a fabulous trainer. He helped me and my pup, Buster, establish great foundational routines and exercises that I was able to implement to our day. My pup loved him and responded so well. He gave us some helpful tips with potty training which was a big challenge of ours. Would highly recommend him!

**🐶 Huge Thank You to Our Amazing Dog Trainer! 🐾**

I just want to take a moment to give a massive shoutout to Rollin for helping us with Buddy’s leash aggression. Walks used to be stressful, filled with pulling, barking, and lunging at other dogs. But thanks to their patience, guidance, and expert training, Buddy has made incredible progress!

Now, our walks are so much more enjoyable, and I feel more confident handling situations that used to be overwhelming. If you’re struggling with leash reactivity or any other behavioral issues, I *highly* recommend Rollin. He truly understands dogs and know how to bring out their best!

🐕‍🦺💕 Thank you again for transforming our walks and giving us peace of mind!

#DogTraining #LeashAggression #Grateful #HappyDogHappyLife

Rollin is an exceptional dog and human trainer.  He has a depth of knowledge that we have not experienced before.  And he was so kind and patient not only with our rescue German Shepherd but with us. We are not exactly great at any kind of training, but with his help, we have a much better understanding of our dog but also of how to incorporate him into our lifestyle.  We couldn't recommend him any more highly.  Beth & Peter Schulberg

As new parents to a 3 month old puppy (Bodhi), we couldn't have been happier with our decision to work with Rollin. He offered a wealth of knowledge and made training fun for all of us. His tips were straightforward and effective. It's been extremely rewarding to see the improvements in Bodhi's behavior after our sessions with Rollin.

Rollin is the best! I've had the pleasure of taking both individual (Puppy Power Package) and group classes (both of which I recommend) for our puppy, who is thriving at 6 months. Rollin is great with pets, and great with kids. My 8 year old, after taking a few lessons from Rollin, is the best at getting our dog to sit, stay, and bow. Thanks Rollin, will recommend you to anyone who ever needs a trainer.

Rollin is an incredible trainer, he’s trained my puppy for the moment we brought him home at 8 weeks (chocolate Labrador), I have two small children so it was very important for our family to feel as knowledgeable as possible and learn how to socialize and train our dog. He’s very punctual, responds quickly, gives plenty of notes, guidance and exercises to do at home. Our puppy is really good with obedience and now we are entering the next phase of training with other dogs which has been so helpful and encouraging. Rollin has also been helpful with slight resource guarding that he right away guided me the same day and after walked me through in a session. Would recommend him any day.

This is my second time raising for Guide Dogs of America and my second time completing Rollin's training course. As with Hashi (now a working guide dog), my current puppy-in-training and I benefitted immensely by working with Rollin. He teaches for real life situations. His techniques are clear and thoughtful. Rollin is not only training my puppy,  but training me how to listen and recognize what my puppy needs to be successful. Thanks again!

As a puppy raiser for Guide Dogs of America (GDA), we are required to take an outside dog obedience class. Rollin came highly recommended and he did not disappoint. My puppy and I learned so much. We were given the tools for successful training beyond our five lesson course. Tools of positive reinforcement and situational solutions for my puppy's particular challenges. I can't say enough about Rollin as an instructor. He is thoughtful canine trainer with tons of energy, and of course, the puppies love him!

Rollin has been so helpful with making sure we’re setting ourselves and our new puppy up for a positive lifetime bond. He takes his time and is proactive in real time during training sessions to point things out or suggest adjustments to our approach. Highly recommend.

Rollin is one terrific trainer! He is smart, gentle, and thorough! He was terrific and taught my wife Doris and I so much about our new puppy Bessie in one lesson! We are looking forward to going to more classes with Rollin! We highly recommend him for anyone that wants to train their dog!

Rollin was instrumental with training our puppy Millie. His trainings were super effective in helping her develop better habits and to reinforce good behavior. Rollin has a wealth of knowledge regarding training all kinds of dogs and was very kind and patient with answering all of our questions. Would absolutely recommend booking with Rollin for any dog of any age and you will be as impressed as we were with how much you (and the dog) can learn!

Rollin was amazing.   First off before even coming we appreciated his communication with us.   He was quick to respond and very clear as to what we should expect.
Within our first session we were able to learn so much about how to train our puppy.  He really took his time to answer any questions we had and gave us loads of information on how to handle our concerns.   He definitely put us at ease as first time puppy parents. We would definitely recommend him.

Rollin is very knowledgable, patient & engaging. We got a new puppy & have an older dog & Rollin was so helpful in learning how to integrate the two of them. Also supported with puppy training & training separately for our older dog. I highly recommend working with him.

Rollin is terrific, so attuned to dogs and their behaviors. It was a pleasure working with him, both in his group classes and for private training. My rescue Aussie Siegmund is frightened of nearly everyone and every dog. He still tries to run at dogs, but he is improving—I wish that I were, too!

When we rescued two chihuahuas and brought them into our home, we were wholly unprepared for the range of behaviors we would quickly encounter. Our male chihuahua was reactive and aggressive on leash towards people and other dogs, and our female chihuahua was incredibly anxious, timid, and fearful of everyone and everything. From the first session, seeing how our pups changed in just one hour with Rollin gave us hope that we would eventually be able to break through the problematic behaviors that our dogs were exhibiting. Over the course of six sessions, Rollin gave us the tools that we continue to use to help our pups adjust to their new surroundings. Seeing how our dogs responded to Rollin's training gave us the confidence that we would also be able to help guide our dogs to more positive behaviors using the methods he provided us with. Now, months later, as our dogs continue to adjust and we learn more about their strong chihuahua personalities, we are grateful that we have all the information and tools that Rollin provided us with. Training reactive dogs can be a difficult journey, but Rollin really helped provide us with some peace of mind.

Rollin is such a gem! He came highly recommended from a friend and I'm so glad we followed through a scheduled a session. He is patient, gentle, and kind with my dog—She loves him!—and has helped me gain confidence as a first-time dog mom. I've worked with several other trainers and Rollin is the top of the heap. He's personable, knowledgeable, and trustworthy, and always has the best interests of both dog and human in mind. I couldn't recommend him more!

Rollin was phenomenal with us and our senior dog, and provided easy training that made it easier for our dog (and his owners) to navigate/handle many of the challenges that come with aging/health issues. Would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for personalized at-home education.
